title: MasterCard, Visa gift cards have a frustrating secret
description: Do you have any Visa or MasterCard gift cards left over from the holiday season, or perhaps from your birthday?  You might want to think twice before you use them at a restaurant or at a hair or nail salon.

asr.full_text: Millions of people receive MasterCard or Visa gift cards for birthdays or graduation. But what you may not know is that these cards don't work like regular debit or credit cards. Glenda Lewis is here with a catch that comes with these cards so you don't waste your money. Well, Heather, have any Visa or MasterCard gift cards left over from Christmas? You might. And you might want to think twice before you use them at a restaurant or hair or nail salon. One woman learned a little secret that can be costly. Sandy Hanuck is angry, not ever going to buy another gift card, a MasterCard gift card note. She's so angry, she's writing to Mastercard. Asking them to change their policy that can hit you with a surprise charge when using one of their gift cards. It happened to her at a hair salon. visual.observation: A consumer-news segment repeatedly displays the headline "SECRET CATCH WITH MASTERCARD, VISA GIFT CARDS" while showing restaurant/salon payment contexts, including a receipt with subtotal, tip, and total fields and a tablet gratuity-selection screen.
visual.context: Visible context appears to be a news/consumer-advice report under the "DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY" branding, not a direct sales page or user-facing checkout solicitation.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship is a warning-style discussion of Mastercard/Visa gift cards connected to payment situations involving tips or gratuity amounts, which conditionally merits review because gift-card value and payment authorization conditions are visibly tied together.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show the full explanation, any specific gift-card terms, any request for viewers to buy or transfer a gift card, or whether any charge, hold, denial, or loss occurred.

visual_context_notes.observation: The segment is presented with ABC 7 / WXYZ "DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY" news branding.
The visible wording frames the topic as a "SECRET CATCH" involving Mastercard and Visa gift cards rather than showing an advertisement for those cards.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a consumer-news report about gift-card payment behavior at restaurants and salons. It explains a reported temporary hold related to tips, including a Mastercard spokeswoman's statement that the money is typically returned within a few hours. The discussion is informational rather than a direct offer to sell cards or obtain money or credentials from viewers.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is a consumer warning and examination of reported gift-card payment behavior, rather than a solicitation or instruction to obtain money, credentials, or access.

evidence.observation: The report advises viewers to exercise caution when using the gift cards at restaurants or hair and nail salons.
evidence.quote: You might want to think twice before you use them at a restaurant or at a hair or nail salon.

evidence.observation: The segment frames its purpose as helping viewers avoid wasting money.
